If the candidate has a Master's degree in Plastic Engineering / Technology, first class or equivalent is required at Bachelors or Masters level. selection_process: Please refer to the official notification for selection process details.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Government Polytechnic Daman Lecturer in Plastic Engineering Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://ddd.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Government Polytechnic Daman Lecturer in Plastic Engineering Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Lecturer in Plastic Engineering post is 15th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Lecturer in Plastic Engineering post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Plastic Engineering/Technology with First Class or equivalent. A Master's degree in the same field with First Class is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Lecturer in Plastic Engineering post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lecturer in Plastic Engineering position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job for a period of six months.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website and submitting it via hand, speed post, or courier to the Principal, Government Polytechnic, Daman.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Government Polytechnic Daman, which is https://ddd.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I attach with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to attach one passport-size photograph pasted on the application and duly self-attested copies of required documents as per the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Lecturer in Plastic Engineering.

faq.question: Q10. Who should I contact for further queries?
faq.answer: For further updates and queries, applicants are requested to log in to the official website https://ddd.gov.in/.
